sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 1973
ACT I OF 1973
WEST PAKISTAN
SHOPS AND ESTABLISHMENTS (BALUCHISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act to amend the West
Pakistan Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969 (West Pakistan Ordinance No.
VIII of 1969)
[Gazette of
Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 13th January 1973]
No. Legis. 1-49/Law/72.---The
West Pakistan Shops and Establishments (Baluchistan Amendment) Act, 1973,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Baluchistan on the 2nd January
1973 and assented to by the Governor of Baluchistan on the 10th day of January
1973 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of
Baluchistan.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the West Pakistan Shops and
Establishment (Baluchistan Amendment) Act, 1973.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

ACT I OF 1973
ACT I OF 1973
WEST PAKISTAN
SHOPS AND ESTABLISHMENTS (BALUCHISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act to amend the West
Pakistan Shops and Establishments Ordinance, 1969 (West Pakistan Ordinance No.
VIII of 1969)
[Gazette of
Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 13th January 1973]
No. Legis. 1-49/Law/72.---The
West Pakistan Shops and Establishments (Baluchistan Amendment) Act, 1973,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Baluchistan on the 2nd January
1973 and assented to by the Governor of Baluchistan on the 10th day of January
1973 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of
Baluchistan.
2. Amendment of section 6 of
Ordinance No. VIII of 1969.---In section 6, subsection (4), after the word
"Sunday" the full-stop shall lab deleted and the following proviso
shall be inserted :----
"Provided
that in the case of Barber's and Hairdresser's Shops, these shall remain
entirely closed on any one day of the week except Friday rind Sunday".
Repeal.---The West
Pakistan Shops and Establishments (Baluchistan Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
(Baluchistan Ordinance No. XV11 of 1972) 6 hereby repealed.
